What is the AIR India Talent Acquisition Internship?

AISATS is a leading gateway services provider in India, handling everything from passenger services to cargo management. To support their massive workforce operations, they are currently hiring a proactive Talent Acquisition Intern.

Selected candidates will operate directly from the AISATS office located in Andheri East, Mumbai. The role offers deep hands-on experience in the complete end-to-end corporate hiring process.

Students will learn the core fundamentals of talent sourcing, candidate engagement, and modern employer branding. This paid internship program will run for a flexible duration of either six months or one full year, depending on company requirements.

Role and Responsibility

Working in the human resources department of a major aviation brand requires focus and dedication. Interns will work closely with experienced hiring managers to manage the daily recruitment workflow.

Your primary duties during this tenure will include:

Sourcing potential candidates through digital job portals, social media, and professional referrals.

Screening applicant resumes and scheduling daily corporate interviews.

Coordinating with hiring managers and interview panel members for seamless logistics.

Maintaining recruitment trackers and regularly updating the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

Supporting large-scale campus hiring events and walk-in recruitment drives.

Helping prepare daily recruitment reports and data dashboards.

Assisting in employer branding activities, including creating flyers and social media posts.

Handling direct candidate communication and vital follow-ups.

Who Can Apply for Air India Internship 2026?

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • Pursuing or recently completed a MBA in HR, Business, or related field

PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS & BEHAVIOUR

Interest in aviation or ground handling industry is a plus.

Strong communication and organizational skills.

Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and basic data handling.

Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.
